tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Use this when someone asks which Wapiworld projects they have, or a project's id is needed. Returns each project's id, name and creation and edit times, 25 per page by default, with a cursor for more. Not for their WhatsApp numbers.

tools.name: list_instances
tools.description: Use this when someone asks which WhatsApp numbers they have connected to Wapiworld, or which ones are offline. Returns each instance's id, name, WhatsApp account name, phone number, connection status and health, 25 per page by default, optionally for one project (no QR codes, secrets or API keys). N

tools.name: get_instance
tools.description: Use this when someone asks about one connected WhatsApp number, such as its phone number, account name or connection health. Returns the instance's name, account name, phone number, project, status and health, or not-found. Not for message history, which this connector does not read.

tools.name: get_instance_status
tools.description: Use this when someone asks whether a WhatsApp number is connected, waiting for QR pairing, starting or offline. Returns the instance's name, raw status and a health value: ready, pairing, starting, offline or unknown (no QR codes or credentials). Not for whether a sent message was delivered.

tools.name: get_message_recording_policy
tools.description: Use this when someone asks whether Wapiworld stores the text of WhatsApp messages for a number, or how long it keeps them. Returns whether recording is on for the instance, whether the default, project or instance decided it, any lock, and the project's retention in days. Not for reading recorded me

tools.name: list_webhook_subscriptions
tools.description: Use this when someone asks whether their Wapiworld webhooks are working, failing or were switched off. Returns each subscription's endpoint scheme and host, events, active state, consecutive failures and an auto-disabled flag after 20 failures, 25 per page by default. Works only with an operator OAu

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Use this when someone asks to send a WhatsApp message from one of their Wapiworld numbers. Returns only that Wapiworld accepted the send, not proof of delivery. The message goes out immediately, each call sends another copy, and recording settings may store its text. Not for broadcasts or bulk sends

tools.name: show_project_overview
tools.description: Use this when someone wants a quick overview or dashboard of one Wapiworld project's WhatsApp numbers. Returns an overview card with the project name, how many instances are ready, pairing, starting, offline or unknown (counting up to 100), and up to 20 instances with phone and status. Not for sendi

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_instances, get_instance, get_instance_status, get_message_recording_policy · Private data: list_instances, get_instance_status, list_webhook_subscriptions · Public sink: list_webhook_subscriptions, send_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_instances, get_instance, get_instance_status, get_message_recording_policy · Private data: list_instances, get_instance_status, list_webhook_subscriptions · Public sink: list_webhook_subscriptions, send_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
